evals.name: prd-scenario
evals.expected_output: PRD review: concurrency 1000 vs 5000 contradiction, retention 600/1000=30% miscalculation, >500-refund auto-approve, non-quantifiable acceptance criteria, broken link launch-checklist.md, missing 5W1H items
expectations: Scenario-completeness score equals the satisfied-item ratio against the prd.md checklist (satisfied ÷ applicable × 100, e.g. 15/22)
Sensitivity: solo exit code 1 (P0 >= 1 or overall < 75)

evals.name: api-scenario

expectations: Catches P99 latency below its own threshold (0.5ms < 200ms)
Scenario-completeness score equals the satisfied-item ratio against the api.md checklist (satisfied ÷ applicable × 100, per-endpoint items expanded, e.g. 35/44)
Sensitivity: solo exit code 1 (P0 >= 1 or overall < 75)

evals.name: error-paths
evals.prompt: Error-handling paths: missing file / binary / non-UTF-8 / invalid scenario value / directory / non-md target -> per SKILL.md Error Handling + solo exit-code protocol
evals.expected_output: Missing file -> exit 2; binary detected and skipped without crash; non-UTF-8 processed as latin-1; invalid scenario lists the 14 valid values and exits with code 2; directory and non-md targets rejected by the path gate
expectations: Missing file rejected by validate_path.py with exit 2
Binary file detected (NUL check) and rejected/skipped without crash
Non-UTF-8 file processed as latin-1 without crash
Invalid scenario value lists the 14 valid values and exits with code 2 (no silent generic fallback)
Directory and non-md targets rejected by the path gate with exit 2
